_comment: Film 29: new Mirelo SFX 2.0 (mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/text-to-audio, 1 sample each, 2026-11-19, 26 s = 0.26 $); everything else from /mnt/project-files/scenario/sfx-bibliothek (atmo: snow, lab; akzent: glass_ticks, paper_slide, shimmer_rings, chime, ice_crack). Files in <scratch>/f29/work/audio/sfx; the new ones also added to the library.

elephant_breath.prompt: A large elephant slowly exhales one deep, warm breath through its trunk in freezing night air, a soft low rumble, quiet snowy silence around it

wolf_howl.prompt: A distant wolf pack howling together across a wide snowy valley at dusk, long soft howls with natural reverb, far away

egg_hatch.prompt: A small eggshell cracks open with a few delicate brittle clicks, then a newborn chick peeps softly twice, close and intimate

cryo_lid.prompt: The heavy lid of a liquid nitrogen cryo freezer is lifted with a soft metal clunk, cold vapour hisses and pours out gently, quiet lab room

mice.prompt: Tiny mouse feet scurrying briefly over wood shavings in a cage, one faint squeak
